enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Bleeding 6: This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 6d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Humanoid Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.
Feeding 30: On Vorpal Hit: Your target incurs one Negative Level, and you gain +30 temporary hit points. (These Temporary Hit Points last for one minute, or until used to negate incoming damage.)
Fusible: Something about this item looks incomplete. Perhaps in the future it will be compatible with another item to create a brand-new fusion of the two.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
